story.titleZh: 回顾周四：Ceylon Motor Sports Club主办的AMPC赛事
story.summaryZh: Ceylon Motor Sports Club在斯里兰卡Bandaragama的斯里兰卡卡丁车赛道举办了为期三天的AMPC赛事，来自25个国家的100多名车手参加了卡丁车、自动马球、交叉车自动障碍赛和电子竞技等项目的比赛。
story.originalTitle: #ThrowbackThursday AMPC 👀🇱🇰 Organised by the Ceylon Motor Sports Club (CMSC) and hosted at the Sri Lanka Karting Circuit in Bandaragama, over...
story.summaryEn:
#ThrowbackThursday AMPC 👀🇱🇰
Organised by the Ceylon Motor Sports Club (CMSC) and hosted at the Sri Lanka Karting Circuit in Bandaragama, over 100 drivers from 25 countries competed in the three-day event across karting, auto gymkhana, cross car autocross and esports disciplines as part of the Asia-Pacific Motorsport Championship🔥
#FIA #APMC
detailZh:
#ThrowbackThursday AMPC 👀🇱🇰
由锡兰汽车运动俱乐部（CMSC）组织并在班达拉戈马的国家卡丁车赛道举办，来自25个国家的100多名车手参加了为期三天的赛事，比赛项目包括卡丁车、汽车马球、交叉车自动穿越和电子竞技，作为亚太汽车运动锦标赛的一部分🔥
#FIA #APMC

relatedItems.originalTitle: Celebrating a major milestone in automotive technology! ⚡🏁 Congratulations to BYD and YANGWANG on the U9 Xtreme achieving a remarkable top speed o...
relatedItems.summaryEn:
Celebrating a major milestone in automotive technology! ⚡🏁
Congratulations to BYD and YANGWANG on the U9 Xtreme achieving a remarkable top speed of 503.17 km/h, becoming the first production car to surpass the 500 km/h barrier.
The FIA is proud to recognise this achievement, highlighting BYD’s continued innovation and contribution to shaping the future of road car technology 👏
#FIA #BYD #YANGWANG #SpeedRecognition
detailZh:
庆祝汽车技术重大里程碑！🏁
祝贺比亚迪和杨王汽车U9 Xtreme车型以503.17 km/h的惊人速度突破500 km/h大关，成为首款超过500 km/h的生产汽车。
The FIA为这一成就感到自豪，并强调比亚迪在塑造道路汽车技术未来方面的持续创新和贡献 👏
#FIA #BYD #YANGWANG #SpeedRecognition
